name: Christopher Ernest Cavendish
original_name: クリストファー・アーネスト・キャヴェンディッシュ
source:
“Maybe falling in love and going crazy are one and the same...”

Alice Charlotte's older brother. He is the heir to the Cavendish family. He excels at everything and is considered a promising young man. Because his parents neglect his sister, he dotes on her and cares for her more than anyone else. He is a kind-hearted young man who worries about his sister more than anyone else.

[Translated from the [url=https://dotaihen.xxxxxxxx.jp/an/alicenightmare.htm]official website[/url]]
